name: seat_allocation_droop
description: Allocate seats among parties by largest remainder with a Droop, Hagenbach-Bischoff, Imperiali or Hare quota, with an optional electoral threshold. Exact arithmetic; reports each party's quotient and remainder, ties at the cut, and seats taken back when a quota hands out more seats than exist.

quota.description: droop = floor(V/(S+1))+1, hagenbach_bischoff = V/(S+1), imperiali = V/(S+2), hare = V/S

threshold.description: Minimum share of valid votes, in percent, to receive seats

on_overallocation.description: When whole quotas exceed the seats: take seats back from the smallest remainders, or fail

catalog.source: original; quotas as defined in Gallagher & Mitchell, The Politics of Electoral Systems (2005), appendix A, checked against Wikipedia's Largest remainder method example
